newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Grand Coulee dam 750 MW unit still off line.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Grand Coulee dam 750 MW unit still off line.

text.p: A 750 megawatt (MW) power turbine at the Grand Coulee hydroelectric dam in Washington state remains off-line after being shut for unplanned repairs Tuesday, a spokeswoman for the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation said Thursday.
The unit had been expected to restart late Wednesday.
A new estimate for when the unit will be back up was not yet available, the spokeswoman said.
Grand Coulee's total generating capacity is near 2,000 MW, but a segment of its turbines are taken off-line in shifts for regular maintenance.
